summary: Frontend end-to-end journey reached dashboard successfully, but completion UI state failed to update immediately after Mark complete.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking next-action-complete-button only saves completed=true to localStorage and dispatches an unused CustomEvent; Dashboard data state is never updated, so success label, progress, and streak remain at incomplete values until refresh.

action_items: Update Dashboard markComplete to update parent/local React data state (or otherwise re-render) after saving completion, then verify success message, 1 / 1, and 1 Day appear without refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard markComplete persists state but does not call setData; the dispatched life-action-complete event has no listener. This breaks the required immediate completion flow.
Accessibility guideline asks for aria-live on score, success, and progress; these regions currently lack aria-live attributes.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; browser localStorage was cleared and populated only with temporary test state, then cleared by Start over before the failure assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing, all five assessment steps, six ratings, deterministic score 67, lowest Health, six cards, three twin insights, and personalized action passed. Failure occurs immediately after clicking Mark complete before refresh. Mobile overflow check was not reached because the test correctly stopped at this critical failure.
rca of the issue: Dashboard receives data and onReset only. In App.js, markComplete creates next and calls saveState(next), then dispatches CustomEvent(life-action-complete), but no listener updates data state. React therefore renders the old completed=false object. Fix by passing a completion callback/setData into Dashboard or invoking setData(next) inside the completion path; retain saveState for persistence.
